Field voice-note report (swahili). Location: Nyalenda, Kisumu. Symptoms reported: high fever, vomiting. Groups mentioned: children under five. Sent for supervisor review: yes (children under five, urgent follow-up requested, priority: same_day_callback). Summary: Amina Otieno reported visiting eight households in Nyalenda, Kisumu, where three children under five are experiencing high fever and vomiting, and urgent follow-up is needed. Original transcript: Habari, ni mimi Amina Otieno kutoka Nyalenda, Kisumu. Leo ni metembelea nyumba nane. Kuna watoto watatu chini ya miaka mitano, thre children undafiv, wanahoma kali na wanatapika tangu jana. Mama mmoja anasema moskuito neti yake ime raruka. Tafadhali, we need urgent follow-up kesho asubuhi.

Field voice-note report (english). Location: Lenisaba village, Kibera. Symptoms reported: cough, joint pain. Groups mentioned: elderly. Sent for supervisor review: no. Summary: Grace Wanjiru reported visiting 12 households in Lenisaba village, where she noted two adults with a mild cough and one elderly man with joint pain. Original transcript: This is community health worker Grace Wanjiru reporting from Lenisaba village in Kibera. Today I visited 12 households. Two adults have had a mild cough for three days, then one elderly man complained of joint pain. All the households I visited are using their mosquito nets. No other concerns. Routine follow-up next week.

Field voice-note report (swahili). Location: Likoni, Mombasa. Symptoms reported: swelling, headache. Groups mentioned: pregnant women. Sent for supervisor review: yes (pregnant women, supervisor requested, priority: supervisor_review). Summary: The report details a visit to three pregnant women, one of whom has swelling and a severe headache. Original transcript: Ripoti kutoka Likoni, Mombasa. Leo ni mewatembelea akina mama wajawazito watatu. Moja ana uvimbe kwenye migu na maumivu makali ya kichwa. Wengine wawili wako salama. Naomba msimamizi angalie ripoti hii Leo.
